title: Runtime error
summary: Typed client errors exposed by this compatible client mirror.
purpose: Preserves a stable client error identity while carrying normalized status and details.
lifecycle: Created when validation, transport, or upstream execution fails and propagated to the caller.

behavior.errors: ApiClientError is the normalized error surface; details can remain unknown.
behavior.retry: Retry only when explicit status or provider guidance makes the operation safe.
behavior.cancellation: Abort-related errors may represent local cancellation rather than upstream termination.
behavior.streaming: Stream transport failures may surface as ApiClientError.

valid.expected: The caller may apply bounded retry policy.

invalid.expectedFailure: An empty diagnostic does not satisfy the documented constraint.

compatibilityNotes: Provider error payloads are not canonicalized beyond the packed client type.
